![](images/38/38004f5c93b047155973d32caa632c2c506d526c09ea891a7a02864997860f0e.png)

The area of $ABCD$ is $15in^{2}$. What is the area of $△BCD$ rounded to the nearest integer?

> A scientific calculator is required to answer this question.
corrected_content.worked_solution: The large triangle $ABD$ has area $\tfrac12(12)(9)\sin117^\circ\approx48.11435\,\mathrm{in}^2$. The concave quadrilateral is the part remaining after removing $\triangle BCD$, so $$[BCD]=[ABD]-[ABCD]\approx48.11435-15=33.11435\,\mathrm{in}^2.$$ Rounded to the nearest integer, the answer is $33\,\mathrm{in}^2$.
